audit_metadata.grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings exceed C-grade threshold (max_p1=2). 12 P2 findings also exceed B-grade threshold (max_p2=8). First audit — no prior baseline.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.description: When Vitest UI server is running, any attacker on the same network can read and execute arbitrary files on the developer's machine.

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.description: JavaScript injection via AST Type Confusion when processing template @partial-block. If any user-controlled templates are compiled, arbitrary JS executes in the Node process.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Schema Injection
escalations.description: Crafted malicious .proto schema injected into protobufjs deserialization triggers arbitrary JavaScript execution in the orchestrator process. Full RCE with orchestrator-level privileges.

findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind Spot — portal/ and platform/ Excluded from Scans
findings.description: Enforcer scans only Source/ and E2E/. 83 of 97 requirements implemented in portal/ and platform/ are invisible to the gate. Agents see false-green compliance.
findings.recommendation: Extend source_dirs to include portal/ and platform/. Solo session (tools/ scope).
findings.cross_ref: Also see QO-010 (false positives from same enforcer)

findings.title: workflow-engine.md Has No FR-XXX Identifiers — Spec is Permanently Unenforceable
findings.description: The canonical domain spec for the work-item workflow system has no FR-XXX IDs. It cannot be referenced by Verifies: comments or scanned by the enforcer.
findings.recommendation: Add FR-WF-XXX IDs matching Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md. Owned by requirements-reviewer agent.

findings.title: Route Handlers Call Store Directly — No Service Layer in Source/Backend
findings.description: workItems.ts, intake.ts, and workflow.ts call workItemStore.* methods directly. Architecture rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts wrapping all workItemStore calls. Route handlers call service only.

findings.title: portal/Shared/api.ts Missing blocked_by Field on Update Input Types
findings.description: UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput lack blocked_by?: string[]. DependencyPicker.tsx uses 'as any' casts at lines 291 and 293 as workaround.
findings.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both interfaces. Remove as any casts from DependencyPicker.

findings.title: portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts Absent — FR-dependency-seed Unimplemented
findings.description: FR-dependency-seed requires an idempotent seed file inserting 4 known dependency relationships. File does not exist. Fresh environments have no demo dependency data.
findings.recommendation: Create seed.ts with idempotent insert logic. Wire into portal/Backend/src/index.ts startup.

findings.title: Source/Backend Logger Always Emits JSON — No Dev Pretty-Print Mode
findings.description: emit() unconditionally writes JSON. Architecture rule requires pretty-printing in development. Additionally, two logger abstractions exist (utils/logger.ts and src/logger.ts).
findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV check to emit(). Consolidate to single logger entry point.

findings.title: Express Denial of Service via qs Query String
findings.description: Malformed query string arrays crash the server via qs library. Zero-precondition exploit — any HTTP client.
findings.fix: npm install express@>=4.22.2 across all three modules

findings.title: Vite Path Traversal and Windows Filesystem Bypass
findings.description: .map files in optimised deps accessible via path traversal. Windows UNC bypass to fs.deny rules.
findings.fix: npm install vite@>=8.2.0 (major upgrade — requires regression testing)

findings.title: Brace-Expansion Denial of Service (3 CVEs)
findings.description: Process hang, exponential-time expansion, OOM crash via specially crafted input.
findings.fix: npm audit fix or update affected transitive chain

findings.title: Form-Data CRLF Injection via Multipart Field Names
findings.description: Unescaped multipart field names allow HTTP response splitting / header injection attacks.

findings.title: PostCSS Multiple Vulnerabilities — XSS, Arbitrary File Read
findings.description: XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS output, arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL, path traversal in source map auto-loading.
findings.fix: Update postcss to latest stable via npm audit fix

findings.title: React Router DOM Vulnerability
findings.description: React Router has known vulnerability present in npm audit output (details truncated in audit). Update required.

findings.title: WebSocket Memory Exhaustion Denial of Service
findings.description: Specially crafted WebSocket frames with tiny fragments cause memory exhaustion and process crash.

findings.title: gRPC Malformed Request Server Crash
findings.description: Malformed requests or compressed messages cause server crash. Zero-precondition from network.

findings.title: FR-TMP-008 Has No Verifies: Traceability Comment
findings.description: FR-TMP-008 (Worker Container Prerequisites) is the only tiered-merge-pipeline requirement with zero traceability in any file.
findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-008 to Dockerfile.worker. Solo session only (platform/ scope).

findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 Files — Potential Stale Closures
findings.description: Suppressing exhaustive-deps without documentation may hide stale closure bugs causing cached values that don't update.
findings.recommendation: Investigate both sites. Document intentional suppressions or add missing dependencies.

findings.title: portal/Frontend/src/api/client.ts Exceeds 500-Line Threshold (525 lines)
findings.description: Single file covers 9+ entity domains. Creates merge conflicts and makes domain-isolated testing difficult.
findings.recommendation: Split into api/featureRequests.ts, api/bugs.ts, api/cycles.ts etc. with barrel re-export in api/index.ts.

findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Matches Seed Data FR References — False Negatives
findings.description: Pattern FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ matches seed data references like FR-0002 in requirements files, reporting them as unimplemented requirements. Trains agents to ignore traceability failures.
findings.recommendation: Tighten pattern to FR-[A-Z]+-\d+ or FR-\d{3,}. Solo session (tools/ scope).

findings.title: uuid Missing Buffer Bounds Check
findings.description: Buffer overflow in v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided. Only exploitable with attacker-controlled buffer.

findings.title: body-parser Silently Disables Size Enforcement on Invalid Limit
findings.description: Invalid limit value silently disables request size enforcement — attacker can bypass size limits.
findings.fix: Update via express upgrade (body-parser is express dependency)

findings.title: Babel Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL Comment
findings.description: Babel reads arbitrary files via sourceMappingURL in source files. Requires attacker to control source input. Dev-time risk.

findings.title: Protobufjs Multiple DoS Vectors (5 CVEs)
findings.description: Infinite loop, recursive JSON expansion, unbounded Any expansion, overlong UTF-8, schema shadowing properties.
findings.fix: npm install protobufjs@>=7.7.0 (same fix as DEP-003 — one update resolves 6 findings)

findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via Multi-Parameter Routes
findings.description: Route parameter parsing with multiple params causes exponential regex backtracking.

findings.title: @protobufjs/utf8 Accepts Overlong UTF-8 Sequences
findings.description: Accepts overlong UTF-8 sequences that should be rejected per Unicode spec — potential data corruption.
findings.fix: Resolved by protobufjs@>=7.7.0 update (same as DEP-003)

findings.title: esbuild Dev Server CORS Bypass — Any Site Can Read Responses
findings.description: Development server allows any website to send requests and read responses. Dev-time only; not a production risk.
findings.fix: Update vite to >=8.2.0 (esbuild upgrades with vite)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Traceability enforcer scans only Source/ and E2E/
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Extend source_dirs in tools/traceability-enforcer.py + tighten FR regex pattern
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 2 findings, unblocks 83 previously invisible requirements

cross_reference_map.single_fix: npm install express@>=4.22.2 across Source/Backend, Source/Frontend, platform/orchestrator

cross_reference_map.root_cause: No WorkItem service layer in Source/Backend
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves architecture violation, enables unit testing of business logic
Resolves 2 findings — path traversal + esbuild CORS bypass

grading_detail.why_not_C: 5 P1 findings exceed C-grade max_p1=2 threshold
